newsitem.title: USA: Fed seen adding reserves via system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed seen adding reserves via system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve Bank of New York is expected to add temporary reserves to the banking system on Friday through weekend system repurchase agreements, analysts said.
"We're expecting a weekend system RP," said an economist at Stone and McCarthy Research Associates Inc. Analysts at MMS International are also expecting the Fed to add reserves via system RPs.
At 1020 EST/1520 GMT, federal funds were quoted at 5-1/4 percent, in line with the Fed's target.
